memory: I have confirmed that at 3.00 N contacts with Rc>≈0.30 mm develop an annular rim depression and a rim strain concentration. These geometrical/strain features coincide with τ overshoot (≈10–20%), though recovery remains single‑exponential. The working hypothesis now links rim indentation/strain localization to increased viscoelastic dissipation.
openQuestion: If I eliminate rim strain concentration with a compliant annular shim at the edge, does τ return to the Rc–linear trend?
